name: state
meaning: BirdState (0 appear-wait, 1 circle, 2 takeoff, 3 descend, 4 leave)

name: offscreenTicks
meaning: updates counted in state 0 while wasOnScreen == 0; at >= 2 the bird starts circling; zeroed by SetState(0)

name: boxIndex
meaning: index into appearBoxes of the box the bird appeared in (loop variable in state 4); every state entry tests pos x/z against this box

name: orbitDir
meaning: +1/-1 circling direction; negated when the orbit is mirrored (reverseNext)

name: orbitCentreVertCopy
meaning: written = orbitCentre.y in SetState(0); never read

name: orbitAngSpeed
meaning: orbitDir*0x226 (550/4096 turn per second); applied to orbitRot.y and to facing

name: reverseNext
meaning: Rand_Bounded(2) result; when set, the next SetState(1) mirrors the orbit centre through the bird and reverses orbitDir

name: wasOnScreen
meaning: Render copies inst.flags & INST_F_DRAWN here; Update zeroes it every frame

name: orbitRadius
meaning: pos - orbitCentre at the start of a quarter circle; rotated by orbitRot each frame

name: takeoffPos
meaning: pos when leaving the circle for state 2; the orbit centre is shifted by pos - takeoffPos on landing

name: orbitRot
meaning: Euler angle of the orbit (only y is advanced); zeroed per quarter circle

name: appearPos
meaning: centre of the APPEARBOX box Ralph was found in; the bird is teleported here

name: flightStep
meaning: per-frame translation for states 2/3 = Vec3s_ScaleByDt(vel), computed once at state entry

name: appearBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: APPEARBOX id-list (Scn_FindIdList); export boxes {u32 flags; Vec3s min; Vec3s max} | count (+4): count written by Scn_FindIdList
